references.text: Moses gives similar conditions for blessing: to listen to the Lord's voice and keep his commandments
Exhortation to walk in all the ways of the Lord and keep his commandments in order to live well
Command to keep the Lord's commandments, walk in his ways, and fear him
Promise of blessing linked to keeping the commandments and walking in the ways of the Lord
Condition to listen to the Lord's voice and keep his commandments and laws

Blessed are those who walk in the law of the Lord and keep his testimonies
The one who walks according to the Lord's laws and commandments shall live
Exhortation to walk according to the Lord's laws and keep his commandments
Jesus says that those who love him keep his commandments
Love for God is shown by keeping his commandments
